selection_rationale: Representative animal photograph, vehicle render, quadruped fantasy creature, and complex humanoid horror illustration.
cross_domain_verdict: Recognizable quality generalizes across bird, vehicle, quadruped creature, and abstract horror subject.
limitations: The output is intentionally voxel/cuboid-stylized, not photorealistic surface geometry.
A single image cannot establish hidden anatomy or concavities; calibrated views, clip frames, or a mesh are required for evidence-backed hidden geometry.
The benchmark references and comparison sheets are retained locally for evaluation and must not be redistributed without permission.
